title: Unified agent session file
description: Generated from actions/setup/js/types/{agent_session,unified_session}.d.ts. Run make session-schemas; do not edit by hand.

type.description: Native update subtype distinguishes historical Pi text and thinking controls.

usageSnapshot.description: Observed native usage, not an additive accounting contribution.

partial.description: True for an observed streaming fragment, not a finalized refusal.

usageSnapshot.description: Repeated observed metadata, never additive inference usage.

estimatedTokens.description: Native estimates, not measured or additive token usage.

usageSnapshot.description: Repeated observed metadata, never additive inference usage.

AdmissionDecisionData.description: Validated admission allowances, not spend or credentials.

EpisodeLineageData.description: Observed lineage from aw_info.context; hopId identifies the recorded caller.

FirewallSteeringData.description: AWF API proxy steering event-log observation.

errorCode.description: Identifier-shaped provider error code; absent means the provider did not supply one.

FirewallUpstreamErrorData.description: Proxy-written upstream error response, projected without bodies, headers or messages.

aic.description: Sum over priced main-agent requests; absent when no request could be priced.

complete.description: True only when every agent-phase request was attributed and every main request was priced.

ModelBaselineEstimateData.description: Collector-written repricing of main-agent requests at the baseline model; routed runs only.

allowedModels.description: Configured routing candidates as authored (exact ids or gh-aw aliases) without provider prefix; absent means the router default or unknown.

candidateModels.description: Effective router pool sent to AWF as provider-qualified ids or patterns: aliases expanded, narrowed by the model policy; absent when unknown or expression-valued.

routing.description: Configured routing policy, never the router's per-run selection.

models.description: Configured model allow/block policy; empty lists mean no restriction was configured.

maxAiCreditsSource.description: Provenance of the budget: compiled frontmatter, the repository default, or the admission allowance.

baselineModel.description: Concrete main model the run would use without routing, after alias resolution.

ModelConfigData.description: Runner-written configured model policy; absent fields are unknown, not false, empty or zero.

configured.description: AWF's endpoint configuration state; absent when the source did not supply it.

models.description: Advertised model IDs in source order; absent means unknown, not empty.

supportedReasoningEfforts.description: Identifier-shaped reasoning efforts; absent means unknown; a supplied empty array stays empty.

contextWindowTokens.description: Positive context window size in tokens; absent means unknown.

routingModels.description: Routing metadata in source order; absent means unknown, not empty.

rankedChoices.description: AWF route choices in rank order; ranks are one-based array positions.

unavailable.description: Request-telemetry dimensions AWF did not observe, such as `model` and `effort`; not unavailable models.

phase.description: AWF failure phase, such as `primary` or `bootstrap`; not the collection provenance phase.

errorCode.description: Identifier-only provider or AWF error code on failed request records; absent means unknown.

errorType.description: Identifier-only provider or AWF error type on failed request records; absent means unknown.

errorSource.description: Whether a failed request was rejected by the upstream provider or by AWF; absent means unknown.

RuntimeObservationData.description: Runtime observations retain supplied JSON values, including null and false.

index.description: Position in the source's normalized event array, not necessarily a raw line.

timestampMs.description: Ordering key only; numeric native timestamp units are schema-dependent.

native.description: Preserves a source event's preexisting provenance field.

SessionProvenance.description: Collector metadata is separate from native engine event metadata.

SteeringNotice.description: AWF steering notice delivered on a model request.

agentMetrics.description: Exact per-agent accounting snapshot supplied by the engine, not additive usage.

UnifiedSessionUsage.description: Essential accounting projection; parser traces retain their snake_case usage.

agentName.description: AWF caller declaration: declared sub-agent name for `purpose: subagent`; absent for the main agent and AWF-owned traffic.

callerSource.description: Origin of `purpose`: `awf` for AWF-owned traffic, `caller_header` for an `x-awf-caller` declaration.

engineHarness.description: Compiled Copilot harness; absent means unknown, never inferred from engineId.

workflowId.description: Executing workflow reference supplied by the compiler from job.workflow_ref.

workflowRef.description: Executing workflow reference (job.workflow_ref); same value as workflowId.

workflowCallId.description: Current workflow invocation ID from aw_info, separate from the caller's ID.

callerWorkflowRef.description: GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF; identifies the top-level caller in reusable workflows.

serverUrl.description: GitHub server origin, such as https://github.com.

WorkflowJobResultData.description: Conclusion's dependency snapshot, not the still-running conclusion job.
